lastTask: Implement Byte L4a save edited phrase as persisted candidate

projectState.summary: Byte L4a is implemented on codex/byte-l4a-save-edited-phrase and ready for Claude review. The melody editor Save idea action persists the current edit-mode AnchorPhrase as a normal scored phrase candidate with native anchor-phrase/v1 genome on stable per-song branches such as editor-lantern. The save path reuses createAnchorPhraseCandidateGenome, renderPhraseCandidateGenome, scoreProsody, and persistence.writeCandidate; same-phrase saves dedup through the existing content-hash id and branch scoping. The live editor override is preserved, and there is no catalog browse UI, server/schema/scorer change, or new playback path. Validation: build green, six unit suites green, smoke 75/75, db:smoke green, diff-check green; npm audit still reports the known Vite/esbuild advisories.
